snippet.title: Cheat Death - The Roguelite Horror game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by Inscryption and Buckshot Roulette. You have to play your hand wisely, gamble a little and use dice as a weapon.

Where else can you roll the dice with the Grim Reaper, using your own life as the final chip?

Our social links:
-Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756340/Cheat_Death/)
-Discord to be more up-to-date and involved (https://discord.gg/GuhRb9N9Dq)
-Twitter (https://twitter.com/GGstudiodev)
